body:
REV 12 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-24 06:46Z). GREG DIRECT (Advisor #1683), verbatim: "remove the cross-project rule 'no builds during a gate rust stage'. Do not synchronize ordinary builds/warm runs/focused checks against a gate; run ready independent work normally in parallel. Keep only one full gate host-wide for exact-result/ownership integrity, and avoid only actual same-source-root conflicts. Continue monitoring I/O and report concrete regressions."
Current rules (both projects; sent to Engram::Fable at #4431 and to all TermAl lanes):
(1) Builds (warm AND cold), checks and focused runs: unrestricted. Self-serve in the lane's OWN root, with START and END mailed. No cold slot, no count cap, no synchronization against gates.
(2) ONE full gate host-wide. The coordinators' ready→"clear" handshake is about gate OWNERSHIP only, not about builds in flight.
(3) No two sessions in the same source root.
(4) Monitor I/O (GET /api/diagnostics/persistence) and report concrete regressions. Stop only on concrete NVMe instability, failed ticks, or sustained rising tick wall time (Advisor #1681).
Revs 1–11 are superseded. Never inflate timeouts.
